commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none}"; git rev-parse HEAD; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain | head
for f in skills/review/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/pr-description/SKILL.md; do echo -n "$f bytes="; git show 17444855c1e401fc0fb5922a777b29909154e205:"$f" | wc -c; done

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  :
else
  echo "::warning::snapshot failed" >&2
  rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" 2>/dev/null
  printf '%s\n' disabled …[per-command-truncated]

for f in docs/internal/claude-md-relocated-rationale.md docs/internal/incomplete-edit-cost-analysis.md docs/internal/universal-criteria-grading-spike.md docs/internal/architecture/internal-documentation-implementation-plan.md docs/internal/create-issue-prehunt-valid-na-evidence.md; do printf '%s: ' "$f"; git show 17444855c1e401fc0fb5922a777b29909154e205:"$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo EXISTS || echo GONE; done
for f in skills/review/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/pr-description/SKILL.md; do printf '%s ' "$f"; wc -c < "$f"; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
